SELECT id, created_at, updated_at, customer_code, customer_name, contact_name, phone, email, remark, is_active FROM customers
WHERE id IN #{id}
WHERE 1 = 0
ORDER BY customer_code

SELECT id, created_at, updated_at, warehouse_code, warehouse_name, address, city, state, zip_code, country, is_active FROM warehouses
WHERE id IN #{id}
WHERE 1 = 0
ORDER BY warehouse_code
SELECT id, created_at, updated_at, carrier_code, carrier_name, scac, contact_name, phone, email, remark, is_active FROM carriers ORDER BY carrier_code
SELECT id, created_at, updated_at, fc_code, fc_name, address_line1, address_line2, city, state, zip_code, country, is_active FROM amazon_fc_addresses ORDER BY fc_code

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_records, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status < 5) AS open_records, COALESCE(SUM(pallet_qty), 0) AS pallet_qty, COALESCE(SUM(carton_qty), 0) AS carton_qty FROM inbound_records WHERE 1 = 1

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_lots, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 0) AS available_lots, COUNT(DISTINCT marking) FILTER (WHERE marking IS NOT NULL) AS sku_count, COALESCE(SUM(available_pallet_qty), 0) AS available_pallet_qty, COALESCE(SUM(available_carton_qty), 0) AS available_carton_qty FROM inventory_lots WHERE 1 = 1

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_orders, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status < 6) AS open_orders, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 6) AS canceled_orders, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 7) AS exception_orders FROM outbound_orders WHERE 1 = 1
